div.head: Ine 32
div.ab: Gif Wilisc mon hæbbe hide londes, his wer bið CXX scll'; gif he þonne hæbbe healfes, LXXX scll'; gif he nænig næbbe, LX scillinga.
LXXVI. Gif Wilisc mon hæbbe hide londes, his wer bið CXX scill.; gif he þonne healfes hæbbe, LXXX scill.; gif he nænig hæbbe, LX scillinga.
Si homo Waliscus habeat hidam terre, wera sua est centum uiginti solid., si dimidiam habeat, LXXX sol., si nullam habeat, LX sol.
{LXXVI} Gif Wiliscmon hæbbe hide londes, his wer bið CXX sciƚƚ; gif he þonne healfes hæbbe, LXXX sciƚƚ; gif he nænig hæbbe, LX scillinga.
If a Welshman has a hide of land, his wer is 120 shillings; if he, however, has half, 80 shillings; if he has none, 60 shillings.
If a Welshman possesses a hide of land, his wergeld shall be 120 shillings. If, however, he possesses half a hide, his wergeld shall be 80 shillings ; if he possesses no land — 60 shillings.
If a Welshman has a hide of land, his wergild is 120 shillings; if, however, he has a half hide, 80 shillings; if he has none, 60 shillings.
Wenn ein Wälscher Mann [1] Hide Landes besitzt, beträgt sein Wergeld 120 Schill.; wenn er aber ein halbes [Hufenland] besitzt, 80 Schill.; wenn er kein [Land] hat, 60 Schillinge.
If a Welshman possesses [1] hide of land, his wergeld is 120 shillings; but if he possesses half [a hide of land], 80 shillings; if he has no [land], 60 shillings.
